title: Restore the Observatory
description: A progressive Luna tutorial: restore a telescope and share the first starlight.
author: Luna Engine
opening_text: Tonight is the first clear night in weeks. Help Mira restore the old observatory.
help_text: Examine your surroundings. Talk to Mira, open the satchel and repair the lens. Type quests for your journal, or hint door for a clue.
unknown_command_text: That does not quite fit the night’s work. Try help, or name something you can see.

command_assistance.retry_text: Choose one of the listed items.
command_assistance.unavailable_reference_text: Name the object you mean; it is not clear here.

endings.name: First light
endings.text: The restored telescope gathers a field of stars. You earned %score% points. Mira smiles: the observatory is alive again.

endings.name: A little guidance
endings.text: With a little guidance, the stars return. You earned %score% points.

endings.name: Rest for tonight
endings.text: Your hands are too tired. The stars will wait for another night.

effects.text: Mira has left a satchel and a lens frame on the workbench.
